lead: A named class does not satisfy a shape type, whatever its properties are called.
body: `View::y(new Point(3, 4))` against a `{y: int}` parameter is `E0401: expected {y: int}, found Point`, because `rule:types/shape-type`'s width subtyping is shape-to-shape only (`nvs_types::expr::assign`). The only widening a case about a shape receiver can write is a narrower shape; do not design one around the class direction.
